headline: Ironwood Chemicals to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Ironwood Chemicals will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Windsor. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Ironwood Chemicals reports record quarterly revenue
body: Ironwood Chemicals reported revenue growth of 18% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Court freezes assets of Ironwood Chemicals amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Ironwood Chemicals after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.

headline: Ironwood Chemicals appoints new regional sales director
body: Ironwood Chemicals announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Ironwood Chemicals signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Ironwood Chemicals announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Ironwood Chemicals cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Ironwood Chemicals lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Lenders flag covenant breach at Ironwood Chemicals, bankruptcy rumors grow
body: Lenders to Ironwood Chemicals have flagged a covenant breach and are negotiating a standstill. Market commentary has raised the possibility of insolvency proceedings.
